accessibility:
- Uses `role="alertdialog"` for proper screen reader announcement
- Has `aria-modal="true"` to indicate modal behavior — note this does not make background content inert; no `inert` attribute is applied, so background content stays reachable by pointer
- `title` is wired up as `aria-labelledby` and `message` as `aria-describedby`
- Focus moves to the confirm (or cancel, with `focusCancel`) button when opened
- Escape key closes the dialog (when `canCancel` is true) — handled by the underlying [`Modal`](./modal.md), which routes it to the topmost open modal only
- Tab and Shift+Tab cycle within the dialog while it is open — also from the underlying [`Modal`](./modal.md)
- Body scroll is prevented when dialog is open, through the ref-counted lock shared with `Modal`, `Sidebar` and `Loading`
- Confirm/cancel buttons are keyboard accessible
summary: The `Dialog` component provides ready-made confirm and alert dialogs, so a destructive action stays one `await dialog.confirm()` call away.

parts.summary: The `Dialog` component provides ready-made confirm and alert dialogs, so a destructive action stays one `await dialog.confirm()` call away.

props.name: type
props.description: The type/color of the dialog. Default: 'default'.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Callback when confirm button is clicked.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Callback when cancel button is clicked or dismissed.

props.name: showCancel
props.description: Whether to show cancel button. Default: true for confirm dialogs.

props.name: canCancel
props.description: Whether the dialog can be dismissed. Default: true.

props.name: focusCancel
props.description: Focus cancel button instead of confirm. Default: false.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the dialog into a portal target instead of inline. Forwarded to the underlying `Modal`; see its `portal` prop for the accepted values.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the dialog element.
